name: HR Employee Management
description: Company HR system with employees, departments, and salary records. Practice organizational hierarchy and compensation analysis.

tables.name: departments
tables.description: Company department structure with budget and leadership info

tables.name: employees
tables.description: Employee master data with job titles, hire dates, and performance

tables.name: salaries
tables.description: Employee compensation records with base salary, bonuses, and deductions

relationships.description: Each employee belongs to one department
Each salary record belongs to one employee

sample_queries.title: Department Headcount and Total Payroll
sample_queries.description: Employee count and total compensation cost per department
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  d.department_name,
  COUNT(e.employee_id) as employee_count,
  SUM(s.net_salary_idr) as total_monthly_payroll,
  AVG(s.net_salary_idr) as avg_salary
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id
LEFT JOIN salaries s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id
GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name
ORDER BY total_monthly_payroll DESC;

sample_queries.title: Top Performers by Department
sample_queries.description: Highest performing employees in each department
sample_queries.sql:
WITH ranked_employees AS (
  SELECT 
    e.*,
    d.department_name,
    s.net_salary_idr,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.department_id ORDER BY e.performance_score DESC) as rank
  FROM employees e
  JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
  JOIN salaries s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id
  WHERE e.status = 'Active'
)
SELECT 
  department_name,
  full_name,
  job_title,
  performance_score,
  net_salary_idr
FROM ranked_employees
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY performance_score DESC;

sample_queries.title: Compensation Analysis by Job Title
sample_queries.description: Salary statistics grouped by job title
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  e.job_title,
  COUNT(*) as employee_count,
  ROUND(AVG(s.base_salary_idr)) as avg_base_salary,
  ROUND(AVG(s.performance_bonus_idr)) as avg_bonus,
  ROUND(AVG(s.net_salary_idr)) as avg_net_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN salaries s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id
GROUP BY e.job_title
ORDER BY avg_net_salary DESC;
